title: Chintamani Library v2.3.1 (Build 2035) — Native Version Fix & Branch-Aware Portal
releaseNotes: Fixed Installation Error: Bumped versionCode to 2035 to ensure Android OS recognizes it as a legitimate upgrade over split builds (resolves 'App not installed as package is invalid')
Pure 34MB arm64 Standalone Package: Excluded unused architectures to reduce file size from 85 MB to 34 MB, completely resolving mid-download stalls
Dual v1 + v2 Signatures: Verified with META-INF/MANIFEST.MF for full compatibility with all Android device package installers
Direct CDN Storage Resumption: Resolves redirect directly to avoid header drops during Range downloads
Branch-Aware Universal QR Portal: Mehdawal and Khalilabad operate as completely separate datasets from one global branch switcher
Real Seat Counts: Khalilabad = 72 single-hall seats (K01–K72), Mehdawal = 65 single-hall seats (M01–M65)
Anti-Cross-Branch Enforcement: Backend blocks cross-branch seat assignments and attendance check-ins
